policies.name: thoughts_owner_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = thought_snapshots.session_id) AND (s.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

constraints.name: code_reviews_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source = 'paste'::text) AND (file_name IS NULL)) OR ((source = 'file'::text) AND (file_name IS NOT NULL) AND (file_name ~* '^[^/\\]+\.(cpp|cc|cxx|txt)$'::text) AND (length(file_name) <= 160) AND (file_name !~ '[\x01-\x1F\x7F]'::text))))

constraints.name: learning_preferences_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: recommendation_feedback_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: thought_snapshots_session_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES training_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: training_plan_items_plan_id_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (plan_id, user_id) REFERENCES training_plans(id, user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: training_plans_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: training_sessions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (resumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (ended_at IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'paused'::text) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (ended_at IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (resumed_at IS NULL) AND (ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NOT NULL) AND (phase = 'finished'::text))))

constraints.name: training_sessions_problem_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (problem_id) REFERENCES problems(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: training_sessions_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
